title: Open Prior-to-Documents Conditions Buffer, Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — conditions buffer**

The conditions buffer follows the prior-to-documents conditions still open on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File, and it adds its days to the days a Hometown Heroes extension must cover. A condition is open when it has been issued and has been neither cleared nor waived; the number open is the prior-to-documents conditions issued on the file less those cleared and less those waived. Prior-to-funding conditions are not counted.

| Prior-to-documents conditions open | Conditions buffer |
|---|---|
| two or more | 8 days |
| one | 4 days |
| none | nothing |

**Clause.** Two or more open conditions add 8 days, one open condition adds 4 days, and none adds nothing.

### Worked count (hypothetical condition history)

| Prior-to-documents conditions issued | Cleared | Waived | Open | Buffer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 8 days |
| 4 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 4 days |
| 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 | nothing |
